label: help-ingest
stdout:
usage: wiki.py ingest [-h] [--mode {local}]
                      [--only {Assistance Games,Compute Governance,Transformer Safety Limits,Alignment and Interpretability,Human Control and Defenses,Power and Disempowerment}]
                      [--force] [--save SAVE]
                      [source_dir]

positional arguments:
  source_dir            Registered original-source folder (default
                        ./vault/raw)

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --mode {local}
  --only {Assistance Games,Compute Governance,Transformer Safety Limits,Alignment and Interpretability,Human Control and Defenses,Power and Disempowerment}
                        Ingest one registered topic
  --force               Regenerate pages; preserve previous versions in
                        .state/note-backups
  --save SAVE           Save reviewable evidence JSON and Markdown
